manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Classify the visible image-only 修学支援 PDF as review-bound because the URL and anchor do not prove the target application form.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL registered for the school.
Open the public report page and inspect the 修学支援 links.
Follow the anchor R7修学支援に関する資料 to 09_shugakushien_r7.pdf.
Route the PDF to operator review because the URL and anchor identify R7 support material but do not contain a target-form hint such as 様式第2号 or 確認申請.

reusable_rules: Keep image-only 修学支援 PDFs visible in evidence even when strict target-year extraction cannot accept them.
Require both system hints such as 修学支援 and form hints such as 様式第2号 before classifying image-only old-year PDFs as publication lag.
Route support-only image PDFs to operator review instead of non-target noise or publication-lag evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not count an R7 image-only support PDF as FY2026 success.
Do not classify support-only 修学支援 old-year hints as publication lag without a target application-form hint.
Do not treat generic MEXT boilerplate years such as 2020年度対象 as publication-lag evidence.

evidence.notes: Windows v232 targeted replay contains school_id 761 reason=target_fiscal_year_not_detected, pdf_type=image_only, anchor_text=R7修学支援に関する資料. The old-year support label stays visible for operator review but is not publication-lag evidence without a target application-form hint.
